newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * National committee for fighting corruption is expected to hold working session in the afternoon.

* Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea and representatives of the International Monetary Fund, the World Bank and the European Union will hold a joint press conference on Thursday at 2030 local at the end of talks to resume credits to Romania.
* Priority for the lower Chamber of Deputies' foreign policy commission is Romania's integration in NATO in the first wave, commission's chairman Teodor Bostinaru said.

* President Emil Constantinescu meets leaders of the opposition Party of Social Democracy to discuss current situation in Romania and the anti-corruption campaign started by Constantinescu earlier this month. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
